scoring_justification: Phonon frequencies are computed deterministically from public force-constant matrices and parameters; the checker rebuilds the dynamical matrix and compares eigenvalues within tolerance.

outputs.description: File containing the computed phonon frequencies for all branches and q-points. The hidden checker recomputes the frequencies from the same force-constant matrices and compares each value with an absolute tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The agent must set m_A, M, I0 to convenient values (e.g., 1) and scale the parameters accordingly, because frequencies are reported in dimensionless units. The scientific correctness depends on correctly implementing the force-constant matrices and the Brillouin-zone Fourier transform, not on the absolute mass choice.

steps.description: Recompute phonon frequencies from the agent's configuration and compare to the submitted CSV.
